Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

You emphasise cost visibility and have offered to walk us through your calculation—it sounds like a transparent cost basis could make this renewal straightforward. We value the relationship and want a lasting agreement that works for both sides. What scope for improved pricing could a longer agreement create, and could you share the underlying cost breakdown in XLSX so we can work through its elements?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together? We are not a small account for you: we also buy the Angular contact ball bearing 7309 BEP and Deep groove ball bearing 6308-2Z C3 from you, and we want the whole family on the same 36-month footing. Your own quote of 2026-09-20 was EUR 4.63 per unit.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.83 per unit, 45 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month agreement and the increased volume. While our internal policies do not allow us to share detailed cost breakdowns in XLSX format, we have adjusted our pricing to reflect the longer term. 

Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. 

For our Angebot, we can offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. We can offer €4.90 per unit for a 36-month contract with 45 days payment terms. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
